title: OptionChanger
description: This is a mod that cann save ur settings and load them when ever u want
body: This mod cann save ur setttings(controls, keybinds, visuarlsettins and much more) with an client side command /clientsettings save {name}. U can load them also /clientsettings load {name} and u can get a list of all the settingsprofile that u saved /clientsettigns list u cann also delet SettingsProfil /clientsettings delete {name}. If u want to save ur hotbar also try the HotbarChanger mod from me.
